# Vihana Dental Care

> Multispecialty dental clinic in Kalapatti, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India, led by Dr. N. Sanchana, M.D.S. (Orthodontics). Services include painless/laser root canals, computer-guided dental implants, Invisalign and clear aligners, metal/ceramic/Damon braces, cosmetic dentistry, teeth whitening, wisdom-tooth surgery and pediatric dentistry.

## Contact
- Address: No 77, Post Office Street, Kalapatti, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641048, India
- Phone: +91 98943 17823
- WhatsApp: +91 86680 82140
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM–1:30 PM and 5:00 PM–8:30 PM; Sunday 10:30 AM–1:00 PM; emergency care on call
- Rating: 4.9 / 5 on Google (185+ reviews)

## Booking
Appointments can be booked online on the home page ("Book Appointment Online" on any page), or through WhatsApp. The site also exposes WebMCP tools (`get_clinic_info`, `list_dental_services`, `open_booking_form`) to browser agents; booking is only completed by the patient.
